column1: # Java properties counters (.properties: application.properties, messages, log4j, gradle.properties),
# for a rule with the prompt file-body-ops: one per line, label TAB pattern (Java regex). The
# [ignore] line blanks comment lines (# or ! first on the line). "keys (approx)" counts a line that
# starts with a key followed by = or :, so a key separated from its value by a blank alone, and the
# continuation line of a value that holds = or :, are counted wrongly; "keys naming a secret" a key
# with password, passwd, secret, token or credential in it, which the prompt names without its value.
# OpsFactPatternsTest pins every case; ProfileFactPatternsLinearityTest measures that every pattern
